name: Proactive tax advisory firm comparison
methodology: Service descriptions come from official firm websites. Competitor prices are estimated starting levels based on market information available to AE Tax Advisors and must be confirmed directly.

firms.name: AE Tax Advisors
firms.clientFocus: Profitable owners and real estate investors, commonly under $5M of annual business profit
firms.serviceModel: Three-year lookback, amendments, cost segregation, entity strategy, implementation, and filing

firms.name: Peter Holtz CPA
firms.clientFocus: Businesses with $1M or more in revenue
firms.serviceModel: Accounting, proactive tax strategy, profit consulting, CFO advisory, and IRS representation

firms.name: Prime Path Advisory
firms.clientFocus: Founders, executives, and high-RSU earners making $1M+
firms.serviceModel: Year-round strategy designed, implemented, and filed by an attorney- and CPA-led team

firms.name: Rainwater CPA
firms.clientFocus: Seven- and eight-figure business owners nationwide
firms.serviceModel: Quarterly projections, proactive planning, preparation, filing, and tax resolution

firms.name: Neil Jesani Advisors
firms.clientFocus: Mid-market companies, high-net-worth individuals, founders, investors, and family offices
firms.serviceModel: Mid-market advisory, private-client planning, tax controversy, and separate CFP or wealth-management work
firms.startingPrice: $30,000+ per year, plus any separate CFP or wealth-management scope
